issues.body: The live `run_mutants` step both catches `cargo mutants` failure with `|| echo` and has `continue-on-error: true`; its own workflow comment says the job exits success even when cargo-mutants fails. This reporter only reads the job-level `status`/`conclusion`, so an ordinary mutation failure is classified `ok`. The tests manufacture job objects with `conclusion: failure`, bypassing the actual suppression and therefore do not validate the claimed real path. The report can expose timeout/cancellation or unrelated job-level failures, but not the hidden cargo-mutants failures that motivate the PR.
issues.fix_hint: Persist an explicit per-leg outcome that survives `continue-on-error` (for example, a small status artifact or step output uploaded under `always()`), have the report consume those outcomes, and add an integration-shaped fixture matching the live shell behavior where cargo-mutants exits nonzero while the Actions job concludes success. Alternatively stop suppressing the relevant step outcome if the advisory architecture permits it.
issues.title: Jobs API conclusions cannot reveal the suppressed mutation failures

issues.body: `OK_CONCLUSIONS` includes `skipped`, and `unusable_crates` only rejects states other than `ok`. Consequently a skipped leg is counted under the report's `success` column, contributes to “All ... produced a verdict,” and leaves its crate seedable. A skipped mutation leg did not execute and cannot provide the complete outcomes required for seeding; the negative-control test explicitly locks in this incorrect behavior.
issues.fix_hint: Classify `skipped` as an incomplete/non-verdict state (with an appropriate annotation and nonzero verdict), keep only conclusions that prove execution completed in the usable set, and update the green-run test to use actual successful legs while adding a skipped-leg fail-closed test.
issues.title: Skipped legs are incorrectly treated as successful, seedable verdicts

verdict.summary: The reporter's fixtures pass, but they model conclusions that the live mutation job deliberately suppresses, so the new check cannot reliably expose the cargo-mutants failures it claims to report. It also classifies skipped legs as usable for seeding even though a skipped leg produces no mutation verdict/artifact.
